title: The Name That Sank
body: Mara's double reveals the gate took her grandmother's laugh. Sable leads Mara to a flooded archive. Orin admits he guarded the bell and a lie. Mara remembers the name North; the bell rings and a second moon opens under the water.
imageAlt: Mara and Sable at a flooded archive under a crimson moon

panels.caption: 01 — THE GLASS REMEMBERS
panels.imageAlt: Mara faces her double behind glass

panels.caption: 02 — THE DROWNED ARCHIVE
panels.narration: Sable shows Mara the forgotten names.
panels.dialogue: Orin admits, “I guarded the bell—and the lie.”

panels.caption: 03 — NORTH
panels.imageAlt: A bronze bell above dark water

panels.caption: 04 — THE ANSWER BELOW
panels.imageAlt: A second crimson moon opens beneath water
panels.narration: Three taps answer from inside the reflection.
panels.dialogue: A voice like Mara's says, “Thank you.”

ending: From below comes a final request: “Now say your name.” The bell rings again, and the sound seems to come from Mara herself.
